difficulty_reason: The author proves the standard hom-equivalence argument matches the canonical cocone map in a proof-relevant wild categorical setting. This requires an explicit higher coherence between hom-isomorphism naturality and the left-adjoint composition law; the complete proof transports the component equality to the graph-edge equality through the new exchange lemma and several coherent path diagrams. The result is a general sufficient condition for colimit preservation, rather than a routine invocation of the classical 1-category theorem. Applications, counterexamples and their corollaries remain context and are not separate inventory.
